Blind discretionary validation  ·  AU200  ·  120 charts

Can you pick the good ones without seeing the outcome?

Every chart is a real AU200 5-minute session that produced a Logic A signal, drawn up to the close of the entry candle and not one bar further. Dates, years and outcomes are hidden, and the order is randomised across 2019–2026 so the regime cannot be inferred.

09:50 open (DAILY_OPEN) 10:00 body high / low dotted = the 10:00 candle

How to answer

One line per chart, any order, format id direction confidence. Direction is L, S or N for no trade. Confidence is 1 weak, 2 normal, 3 strong — omit it for N.

001 L 2   002 N   003 S 3   004 L 1 …

You do not have to answer all 120 — but decide before skipping, and tell me which you skipped, because dropping the hard ones after looking would bias the result.

Why no feedback until the end

I will not reveal any outcome until every answer is locked. If you learned the result of chart 007 before judging 008, the later calls would be contaminated and the whole experiment would be worthless. The answer key is already written and committed to the repository, timestamped ahead of your responses, so it cannot be adjusted afterwards.
